bookings_scheduled_at_matches_type.name: bookings_scheduled_at_matches_type
bookings_scheduled_at_matches_type.value:
("bookings"."booking_type" = 'scheduled' and "bookings"."scheduled_at" is not null) or
          ("bookings"."booking_type" = 'on_demand' and "bookings"."scheduled_at" is null)

bookings_customer_location_range.name: bookings_customer_location_range
bookings_customer_location_range.value:
"bookings"."customer_latitude" is null or
          ("bookings"."customer_latitude" between -90 and 90 and "bookings"."customer_longitude" between -180 and 180)

bookings_provider_matches_status.name: bookings_provider_matches_status
bookings_provider_matches_status.value:
("bookings"."status" <> 'searching' or "bookings"."provider_profile_id" is null) and
          ("bookings"."status" not in ('accepted', 'en_route', 'arrived', 'in_progress', 'completed') or "bookings"."provider_profile_id" is not null)

bookings_accepted_at_progression.name: bookings_accepted_at_progression
bookings_accepted_at_progression.value: "bookings"."status" not in ('accepted', 'en_route', 'arrived', 'in_progress', 'completed') or "bookings"."accepted_at" is not null

bookings_en_route_at_progression.name: bookings_en_route_at_progression
bookings_en_route_at_progression.value: "bookings"."status" not in ('en_route', 'arrived', 'in_progress', 'completed') or "bookings"."en_route_at" is not null

bookings_arrived_at_progression.name: bookings_arrived_at_progression
bookings_arrived_at_progression.value: "bookings"."status" not in ('arrived', 'in_progress', 'completed') or "bookings"."arrived_at" is not null

bookings_work_started_at_progression.name: bookings_work_started_at_progression
bookings_work_started_at_progression.value: "bookings"."status" not in ('in_progress', 'completed') or "bookings"."work_started_at" is not null

bookings_cancellation_matches_status.name: bookings_cancellation_matches_status
bookings_cancellation_matches_status.value:
("bookings"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("bookings"."cancelled_at" is not null) and
          ("bookings"."cancelled_at" is null) = ("bookings"."cancelled_by_user_id" is null)

provider_profiles_location_pair.name: provider_profiles_location_pair
provider_profiles_location_pair.value: ("provider_profiles"."last_latitude" is null) = ("provider_profiles"."last_longitude" is null) and ("provider_profiles"."last_latitude" is null) = ("provider_profiles"."last_location_at" is null)

provider_profiles_location_range.name: provider_profiles_location_range
provider_profiles_location_range.value: "provider_profiles"."last_latitude" is null or ("provider_profiles"."last_latitude" between -90 and 90 and "provider_profiles"."last_longitude" between -180 and 180)

provider_profiles_decision_has_timestamp.name: provider_profiles_decision_has_timestamp
provider_profiles_decision_has_timestamp.value: "provider_profiles"."verification_status" not in ('verified', 'rejected') or "provider_profiles"."reviewed_at" is not null

reviews_hidden_reason_valid.name: reviews_hidden_reason_valid
reviews_hidden_reason_valid.value: "reviews"."hidden_reason" is null or "reviews"."hidden_at" is not null
